changeSet.author: etecsa
changeSet.comment: Rename existing dato_inversor table to preserve data during migration
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE dato_inversor RENAME TO dato_inversor_legacy; ALTER INDEX dato_inversor_pkey RENAME TO dato_inversor_legacy_pkey;

changeSet.author: etecsa
changeSet.comment: Create dato_inversor as a RANGE-partitioned table on tiempo column (monthly)
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE dato_inversor ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, tiempo TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, bateria_voltaje_v DOUBLE PRECISION, bateria_corriente_a DOUBLE PRECISION, bateria_potencia_w DOUBLE PRECISION, pv_voltaje_v DOUBLE PRECISION, pv_potencia_w DOUBLE PRECISION, salida_voltaje_v DOUBLE PRECISION, salida_potencia_w DOUBLE PRECISION, salida_aparente_va DOUBLE PRECISION, carga_porcentaje INTEGER, red_voltaje_v DOUBLE PRECISION, red_frecuencia_hz DOUBLE PRECISION, modo_operacion VARCHAR(20), codigo_fallo INTEGER, eficiencia_pct DOUBLE PRECISION, consumo_red_w DOUBLE PRECISION, bateria_cargando BOOLEAN, pv_activo BOOLEAN, red_activa BOOLEAN, crc_valido BOOLEAN, latencia_ms INTEGER, inversor_id BIGINT ) PARTITION BY RANGE (tiempo);
-- Primary key includes tiempo for partitioned tables (PostgreSQL requirement) ALTER TABLE dato_inversor ADD PRIMARY KEY (id, tiempo);

changeSet.author: etecsa
etecsa
changeSet.comment: Create inversor_id index on the partitioned table (applies to all partitions)
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_dato_inversor_inversor_id ON dato_inversor (inversor_id); CREATE INDEX idx_dato_inversor_tiempo ON dato_inversor (tiempo);

changeSet.author: etecsa
changeSet.comment: Copy data from legacy table into the new partitioned table
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO dato_inversor SELECT * FROM dato_inversor_legacy ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

changeSet.comment: Re-add FK constraint from dato_inversor.inversor_id to inversor.id
